public_health_question.v: How sensitive are rapid antigen tests for SARS-CoV-2 compared with RT-PCR and viral culture during a period of greater population immunity and Omicron circulation?

ev.q: The objective of this investigation was to reevaluate the performance characteristics of SARS-CoV-2 antigen tests with those of RT-PCR and viral culture tests
SARS-CoV-2 Viral Shedding and Rapid Antigen Test Performance
Antigen test sensitivity was calculated using RT-PCR and viral culture as references.
This evaluation included participants enrolled in an antigen test substudy within a case-ascertained household transmission study
Respiratory Virus Transmission Network, November 2022–May 2023
sites that participated in the antigen substudy were located in Arizona, Colorado, New York, Tennessee, and Wisconsin.
